Method of Attack: Distributed via IQY file attachments in malspam emails
IQY files execute remote PowerShell commands to download and execute ransomware executable (1.exe)
Encrypts files and drops ransom note
Uses Excel Web Query files to execute remote commands
Impacted Systems: Microsoft Windows systems running Microsoft Excel
Attack Vector: Malspam email with IQY file attachment
Indicators of Compromise: Remote command downloading 1.exe to Temp folder
Ransom note named '!!! ALL YOUR FILES ARE ENCRYPTED !!!.TXT'
